name: ChartMimic
intro: ChartMimic 是评估大型多模态模型视觉接地代码生成能力的基准。论文版本包含1,000个人工策划的图表、指令、代码三元组，等分为Direct Mimic与Customized Mimic，覆盖18种常规和4种高级图型、191个子类别，并以可执行的多级指标比较生成图表与真值。
org: Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of General Artificial Intelligence, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
build_method: CC BY 4.0 arXiv图筛选, 多样性与信息密度过滤, 五专家投票, 补充独特图表, 熟练Python标注员人工复现与定制
metric: 执行率, GPT-4o高层得分, 文本/布局/类型/颜色代码追踪F1, 高低层平均总分
eval_feature: Direct/Customized Mimic双任务, 可执行图表代码, 高层与低层多级相似度, 人类相关性验证
scale: 4,800个三元组（Direct 2,400, Customized 2,400）, 22种图型, 201个子类别
build_method_en: CC BY 4.0 arXiv Figure Filtering, Diversity and Information-density Filtering, Five-expert Voting, Distinctive Supplemental Charts, Skilled Python Manual Reproduction and Customization
eval_feature_en: Direct/Customized Mimic Tasks, Executable Chart Code, High- and Low-level Multi-level Similarity, Human-correlation Validation
intro_en: ChartMimic evaluates visually grounded chart-to-code generation. The paper version contains 1,000 human-curated chart, instruction, and code triplets split equally between Direct Mimic and Customized Mimic, covering 18 regular and four advanced chart types with 191 subcategories and executable multi-level similarity evaluation.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the published ICLR 2025 paper arXiv:2406.09961v2 §§2.2–2.4 and Appendix B.2/G, plus official repository snapshot 92ba5b97b908c607f630c3ffbb5043de9de62b76. The v1 scale of 1,000 triplets and 191 subcategories is superseded by v2 and the fixed repository. The reviewed pipeline filters about 174,100 post-February-2024 CC BY 4.0 arXiv PDF figures to about 15,800 Matplotlib-generated PDFs; five domain experts reduce these to 1,295 in a seven-day diversity pass and then 279 by unanimous or ≥3/5 voting; supplemental public examples fill the pool to 600 prototypes. Computer-science master's annotators with 6+ years of Python and matplotlib experience use Python 3.9.0 and matplotlib 3.8.4 to create 600 Direct and 600 Customized seed triplets, then manually add three variants per seed, yielding 4,800 total: 2,400 per task, 201 subcategories, test 3,600 and testmini 1,200. Evaluation uses GPT-4o 0–100 high-level similarity, code-traced Text/Layout/Type/Color F1 averages, their high/low mean as overall score, and zero high/low scores on execution failure; execution rate is reported separately. Appendix G validates the metrics on 300 Direct test examples evaluated under four GPT-4o prompting methods, producing 1,200 outputs; three human evaluators assess each output and agreement is measured with Pearson correlation.
